crm.get_notes.description: Get notes for a deal. Notes are free text written by sales reps.

crm.list_deals.description: List deals. Paginated: pass the returned next_cursor to get the next page. Optional stage filter.
conventions: This tool paginates results using a 'next_cursor' field. To get all items, calls must be made repeatedly, passing the 'next_cursor' value as the 'cursor' argument, until 'next_cursor' is null.
The 'stage' argument accepts values like 'qualified' and 'negotiation'. The response includes a 'next_cursor' field for pagination, even if null for a given call.
The tool paginates using 'next_cursor'; continue calling with the 'cursor' argument until 'next_cursor' is null to retrieve all items.
Returns a list of owner objects, each with 'id' and 'name' fields, which can be used to create a lookup map for owner IDs.

tracker.add_label.description: Add a label to an issue. Label must exist (see list_labels).

tracker.assign_issue.description: Assign an issue to a member by member_id (m_XX).

tracker.list_issues.description: List issues. Paginated via next_cursor. Optional status filter (open|closed).
conventions: The tool paginates using a 'cursor' field. Continue calling with the 'next_cursor' value until it is null to retrieve all items.
The `list_issues` tool paginates results using a `cursor` field. The `next_cursor` in the response should be passed as the `cursor` argument in subsequent calls until `next_cursor` is null.
